optimizedDescription.value: GraphStore defines durable, atomic, backend-neutral graph persistence, querying, search, lifecycle, and generation semantics.

# Graph Store

## Rules

- `GraphStore`: abstract class in `domain/ports/`; constructor `storagePath`; adapters in `infrastructure/`; implementations own backend schema/layout.
- Persist minimum semantics: `FileNode` with canonical workspace path, normalized `configRelativePath`, full textual content, `contentHash`; `SymbolNode`; `SpecNode`; `DocumentNode`; relations `IMPORTS`, `DEFINES`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXPORTS`, `DEPENDS_ON`, `COVERS_FILE`, `COVERS_SYMBOL`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`; metadata `lastIndexedAt`, `lastIndexedRef`, graph fingerprint. `COVERS_FILE`: spec→file. `COVERS_SYMBOL`: spec→symbol; MAY preserve `metadata.stale`. Backends MAY vary representation but MUST preserve observable `GraphStore` semantics. Support document upsert/removal/full-text search and `contentHash` incremental matching.
- Lifecycle: `open(): Promise<void>` prepares backend, bindings, schema/indexes, generation checks. `close(): Promise<void>` releases resources and MUST be idempotent. Operations while unopened/closed throw `StoreNotOpenError`.
- `recreate(): Promise<void>` destructively resets persisted storage, stronger than `clear()`: remove prior graph, prepare fresh indexing, hide backend files/WAL/schema/search mechanics. `CodeGraphProvider` owns recreation decisions; hosts MUST NOT manage backend reset directly.
- Every persisted backend stores generation marker under storage root; `recreate()` rotates it; provider caches generation at `open()` and compares before reads. Format unspecified; `graph/storage.epoch` valid.
- `upsertFile(file: FileNode, symbols: SymbolNode[], relations: Relation[]): Promise<void>` atomically replaces file, its symbols, relations; failure preserves prior state.
- `addRelations(relations: Relation[]): Promise<void>` purely adds cross-file relations. Re-upserting endpoint MAY remove them; indexer re-adds after upserts.
- `removeFile(filePath: string): Promise<void>` atomically removes file, symbols with matching `filePath`, and relations referencing file or symbols.
- Queries:
  - `getFile(path: string): Promise<FileNode | undefined>`; `findFilesByConfigRelativePath(path: string): Promise<FileNode[]>`; `getSymbol(id: string): Promise<SymbolNode | undefined>`.
  - `getCallers(symbolId: string): Promise<Relation[]>` / `getCallees(symbolId: string): Promise<Relation[]>`: incoming/outgoing dependency relations, minimum `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`.
  - `getImporters(filePath: string): Promise<Relation[]>` / `getImportees(filePath: string): Promise<Relation[]>`: incoming/outgoing `IMPORTS`.
  - `getExtenders` / `getExtendedTargets`: incoming/outgoing `EXTENDS`; `getImplementors` / `getImplementedTargets`: incoming/outgoing `IMPLEMENTS`; `getOverriders` / `getOverriddenTargets`: incoming/outgoing `OVERRIDES`; each `(symbolId: string): Promise<Relation[]>`.
  - `getSpec(specId: string): Promise<SpecNode | undefined>`; `getSpecDependencies` / `getSpecDependents`: outgoing/incoming `DEPENDS_ON`; `getCoveredFiles` / `getCoveredSymbols`: outgoing `COVERS_FILE` / `COVERS_SYMBOL`; `getCoveringSpecsForFile(filePath: string)` / `getCoveringSpecsForSymbol(symbolId: string)`: incoming coverage; relation queries return `Promise<Relation[]>`.
  - `findSymbols(query: SymbolQuery): Promise<SymbolNode[]>`. `SymbolQuery`: optional `name` glob/regex, `kinds: SymbolKind[]`, `filePath` exact/glob, `comment` substring, `caseSensitive` default `false`; insensitive `name`/`comment` when false.
- `getStatistics(): Promise<GraphStatistics>` returns `fileCount`, `symbolCount`, `specCount`, `relationCounts: Record<RelationType, number>` including `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`; distinct `languages`; latest-upsert ISO 8601 `lastIndexedAt`; persisted VCS `lastIndexedRef` or `null`; persisted `graphFingerprint` or `null`.
- `upsertSpec(spec: SpecNode, relations: Relation[]): Promise<void>` atomically replaces spec and outgoing `DEPENDS_ON`; `removeSpec(specId: string): Promise<void>` removes spec and all incoming/outgoing `DEPENDS_ON`.
- Search: `searchSymbols(options: SearchOptions)`, `searchSpecs(options: SearchOptions)`, `searchDocuments(options: SearchOptions)` rank descending; `rebuildFtsIndexes(): Promise<void>`. Results MUST include match-aware snippet and 1-based `startLine`/`endLine`.
- Primary identities: specs=`specId`; symbols=`name`,`id`; documents=`path` plus persisted alternate identity such as `configRelativePath`. Identity outranks generic content but MUST NOT replace generic retrieval. Backend MAY add identity candidates missed by tokenizer.
- Shared lexical expansion before identity ranking: preserve normalized original token; split whitespace, `:`, `/`, `_`, `.`, `-`, CamelCase/PascalCase. Lexical only. `core:change`→`core:change`,`core`,`change`; `ArchiveChange`→`archivechange`,`archive`,`change`.
- Ranking: exact canonical identity; exact primary name/alternate identity; primary-identity prefix/suffix/substring token; structured identity/path component above arbitrary substring. Token strength: exact `x` > prefix `x%` > suffix `%x` > substring `%x%`. Component `core` in `core:change` outranks substring in `score`. More matched expanded tokens outrank fewer. Generic BM25/equivalent ranks remaining hits.
- `SearchOptions`: required `query`; `limit` default `20`; symbol-only `kind`, case-insensitive `filePattern` glob; `workspace`; case-insensitive glob `excludePaths`; `excludeWorkspaces`. Apply filters before limit.
- Bulk: `clear(): Promise<void>` removes all nodes/relations; `getAllFiles(): Promise<FileNode[]>`, `getAllSpecs(): Promise<SpecNode[]>` support incremental diffing.

## Constraints

- Abstract class, never interface; no backend, physical schema, or filesystem layout prescribed.
- File-level mutations atomic; no partial updates.
- `recreate()` backend capability owned by provider/indexing flows; no caller-managed backend deletion.
- Persisted generation markers enable cross-process stale-provider detection.
- No `@specd/core` dependency; errors extend `CodeGraphError`.
